lines.text: The root is Port! Transport, import.
Did you know? Port is Latin for carry.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus carry?

words.ex: The city is improving its public transport.
The country imports most of its oil.

publish.title: Port root: transport and import
publish.value: Port comes from Latin "portare" (to carry). Words: transport and import. transport = trans + port; import = im + port.
